items.title: My take in @thehill on US Treasury Sec. Bessent's DOUBLING of US gov't BUYBACKS OF LONG-TERM DEBT: "Sec. Bessent is trying to control the yield curve and keep those long-bond prices higher and the yields lower. But the problem is, if he buys them back, he still has to finance the deficit. So he is going to have to issue more of the short-term debt. Yield curve control is a fool’s game.”
